projects.name: Sub-Agent Infrastructure
projects.progressSummary: Sub-agent spawning and model routing are validated; coordination and recovery patterns still need hardening.

projects.detailedStatus: Core spawn flows are stable, but production readiness depends on proving handoff reliability and codifying failure-playbooks.
notes: Basic sub-agent spawning works in real usage.
Model routing policy exists (haiku/sonnet/opus by complexity).
nextSprint: Run agent-to-agent messaging tests.
Run handoff chain tests (A -> B with full context).
Test recovery after forced agent reset.
Publish ORCHESTRATION.md patterns.
blockers: Inter-agent comms pattern not fully validated.
recommendations: Adopt the phase-3 verification contract for all coding sub-agent tasks.
Add telemetry tags for handoff and retry attempts.
backlog: Automated chaos test scenarios for sub-agent failures.
